items.title: Baker Mayfield: Questionable for Week 11
items.text:
Mayfield (foot/thumb) is officially listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Detroit.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Carnell Tate: Full practice, but questionable for Sunday
items.text:
Tate (shoulder), who was a full participant in Friday's practice, is listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Cowboys.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Joe Burrow: Expects to be full strength for MNF
items.text:
Burrow (illness) said Friday that he's getting better, noting that he "for sure" feels optimistic he'll be at full strength for Monday night's game against the Commanders, Kelsey Conway of The Cincinnati Enquirer reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emmett Johnson: Ticketed for lead-back duties again Week 11
items.text:
With Kenneth Walker (groin) ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Johnson is in line to handle workhorse duties for the second straight week, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Brock Bowers: Listed as questionable versus Denver
items.text:
Coach Klint Kubiak said Friday that Bowers (ankle) is slated to be listed as questionable for Sunday's game against the Broncos, Sam Warren of The Athletic reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
